title: Studying AI Act Mentions: A first look at the impact of the European Union's AI regulation on Hugging Face
abstract: arXiv:2611.26050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) entered into force in August 2024, and its obligations apply in stages. Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models have applied since August 2025, and transparency rules since August 2026. These obligations affect developers who share and deploy models and applications on public platforms such as Hugging Face (HF), the largest platform for distributing AI artifacts. However, little is known about how practitioners respond to the regulation in practice. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical study of explicit references to the AI Act on HF. We collected over five million records, including repository cards, discussions, and commits from Models, Datasets, and Spaces, and identified over 1,500 records that explicitly mention the Act. translated_title: 研究《人工智能法案》的提及：欧盟AI监管对Hugging Face影响的首次观察
translated_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）于2024年8月生效，其义务分阶段实施。针对通用人工智能模型提供者的义务自2025年8月起适用，透明度规则自2026年8月起适用。这些义务影响到在Hugging Face（HF）——最大的AI制品分发平台——等公共平台上分享和部署模型与应用程序的开发者。然而，关于从业者在实践中如何应对该法规，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对HF上明确提及《人工智能法案》的内容进行了实证研究。我们收集了超过500万条记录，包括来自Models、Datasets和Spaces的仓库卡片、讨论和提交，并识别出超过1,500条明确提及该法案的记录。两名编码员采用以封闭编码为主的方法对这些记录进行了手动标注，并按来源分析了由此形成的类别。
tldr: 这是首个针对欧盟《人工智能法案》在Hugging Face平台影响的实证研究，通过分析超过500万条记录中1,500余条明确提及该法案的内容，揭示了AI从业者如何在实践中回应欧盟AI监管。
en_tdlr: This is the first empirical study of the EU AI Act's impact on Hugging Face, analyzing over 1,500 records explicitly mentioning the Act among more than five million collected, revealing how practitioners respond to EU AI regulation in practice.
